statement: The wheels do not turn in the model, and the drag of turning wheels is not part of the drag area
rationale: in the tutorial's case the wheels are still walls: the ground moves with the air at 20 m/s, as the road does under the bike, but the wheels do not turn. A turning wheel changes the flow under the bike and the drag

mechanism.how: A run with a rotating-wall condition on each wheel (the case's ground already moves with the air), compared with this one; or a coast-down test of the real bike
